WHEREAS, the parties hereto desire to merge the Church Property and the Development Property into a single “zoning lot", as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution ofthe City of NewYork,effective December 15,1961(as amended,from time to time, the “Zoning Resolution") and in furtherance thereof, Grantor and Developer are, simultaneously herewith, delivering and submitting for recording a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") (any such zoning lot being referred to herein as a "Zoning Lot"; the Zoning Lot that will constitute the Church Property and the Development Property being referred to herein as the "Combined Zoning Lot"); WHEREAS, the parties hereto agree that the term“Development Rights” shall mean any rights, as determined pursuant to the Zoning Resolution to be appurtenant to a Zoning Lot, whereby such Zoning Lot may be improved by erecting thereon a structure having (a) certain Bulk (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution), and (b) a certain Floor Area (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) determined by multiplying the area of the Zoning Lot by the allowable Floor Area Ratio (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) for structures in the zoning district in which the Development Property and Church Property are located;
